items.title: Bruise Bath – “Non-Consensual Intervention”
items.summary: Philly post-metal band Bruise Bath released a self-titled album this year (not their first eponymous LP). They're not finished. The group returns today with a burly, bass-forward protest song called "Non-Consensual Intervention."
